release_notes: v9.8.27 — CRITICAL fix for company names containing parentheses, ampersands, or quotes. The previous build emitted SVCURRENTCOMPANY with the raw company name; Tally's TDL parser treats raw '(', ')', '&', '<', '>' as expression delimiters and rejects the company-switch with 'Could not set SVCurrentCompany'. Company names like 'Krishna Sales Corporation (from 1-Apr-24)' or 'M/s. Patel & Sons' now have their special characters HTML-escaped (parens become (/), ampersand becomes &, etc.) before being injected into the XML envelope. This unblocks 100% of sync queries for affected customers — every single Tally call (AlterID detection, sales, receipts, purchases, daybook, inventory) was failing silently because of this.
